notes.title: Huntscape | Path of Life
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/2af19b3b152d8324deff80be4e295a9776163420.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*][b]Path of Life[/b] is a line of quests. By completing each quest as a Hunter or Prey you will receive a reward based on the chosen difficulty.

[i]Each quest is different for the players' path. There are quests for the Hunters and quests for the Prey.[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/0af0559fc6bc300c001058b01bde9a55c1b85227.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/1af853e90a70953d75036e499b34299fa0c1c3a2.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[list]
[*]While choosing the [b]quest[/b] you will be given the chance to select a higher [b]difficulty[/b].

[i]The higher difficulty means a more complicated mission but also a greater reward!
[/i]
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/a2fef66818a62bf94f855d9c5f288a8785042636.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/d6af96e36f27b2602ee20e6ad8e31d63f6f053ac.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[olist]
[*][b]Junior Destroyer[/b] 👶
[*][b]The Taste of Meat[/b] 🍖
[*][b]In Plain Sight[/b] 👀
[*][b]Stone Hinged[/b] 🪨
[*][b]Lost Attack[/b] 🗡️
[*][b]Speed Demolish[/b] 💨
[*][b]Sensing the Presence[/b] 🧑‍🦯
[*][b]Nature Rules[/b] 🌳

[i]There will be always more quests to be completed in the game. Whether you're looking for adventure, glory, or just a good time![/i]

[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/9b9c0e3251dfdff3e513a8262791b44688234954.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[olist]
[*][b]Power of Light[/b] 💡
[*][b]Impossible Location[/b] 📌
[*][b]Out of Sight[/b] 🙈
[*][b]True Savior[/b] 🤝
[*][b]Muscle Training[/b] 💪
[*][b]Skilled Survivor[/b] 🌴

notes.notes:

    [tr]
        [th][/th]
        [th][b]Ability[/b][/th]
        [th][b]Type[/b][/th]

        [td]Passive[/td]

    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/7cda30368324084e003b5abf36d3b470b723b87a.png[/img][/td]
        [td]Dodge[/td]
        [td]Active[/td]
        [td][i]Quickly jump forward and perform a roll avoiding all incoming damage[/i][/td]

        [td]Jack Of All Trades[/td]
        [td]Passive[/td]
        [td][i]Perform Orb Pick up and Orb Put down actions at 200% of their normal speed[/i][/td]

    [tr]

        [td]Leapfrog[/td]
        [td]Passive[/td]
        [td][i]Perform slide action at 150% of the normal sliding speed[/i][/td]

        [td]Sense Of Danger[/td]
        [td]Passive[/td]
        [td][i]Each time a teammate is damaged by a hunter - hear your teammate's damaged sound and reveal the hunter for 10 seconds. Can only reveal 1 hunter at a time[/i][/td]

        [td]Swift Awareness[/td]
        [td]Passive[/td]
        [td][i]Activates when the last Orb is placed. Run at 105% of your normal sprinting speed for 30 seconds. Reveal all Levers until the end of the match[/i][/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944757/b0ea80afc89954ca62e5ab02a9c8bedfb70a87ca.png[/img][/td]
